 Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions Double Free Vulnerability: Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions contains a double free vulnerability that could enable remote code execution.

Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
